Addendum/Corrigendum No.NPSC/ADVT-1/04(VOL-1) dt. 10.07.2026 (Combined Technical Services Examination 2026) 
 Published on : 10-07-2026 04:27 pm 
 NAGALAND
PUBLIC SERVICE COMMISSION 
 KOHIMA 
 NPSC/ADVT-1/04 (VOL-1) Dated Kohima, the 10 th July,2026 
 ADDENDUM/CORRIGENDUM 
 With reference to the Nagaland Public
Service Commission Advertisement No. NPSC-2/CTSE-2026 dated 25 th 
June, 2026 the following Addendum/Corrigendum shall be made. 
 1. Item No. 50: ( a) 2(two) posts of Junior
Dental Surgeon (Class-I Gazetted) under Health & Family Welfare
Department . (1 post Unreserved,1 post
reserved for Indigenous Inhabitants of Nagaland) 
 Item No. 50: (b) 14 (fourteen) posts of Pharamacists
(Grade-II) under Health & Family
Welfare Department . 
{(9 posts reserved for Indigenous Inhabitants of Nagaland, 1 post each reserved for B.T. Chang, B.T. Khiamniungan,
B.T. Konyak, B.T. Sumi (Kiphire) & B.T. Pochury)} 
 2. Item No. 51: 3 (three) posts
of Extension Officer under Sericulture
Department . 
 {( 2 posts
reserved for Indigenous Inhabitants of Nagaland, 1 post reserved for B.T. Phom) 
 Elective
subjects to be opted and Pay Matrix
/level: 
 Item No. 
 Elective
 subject(s) 
 Level 
 50a 
 BDS
 13 
 50b 
 Pharmaceutical
 Science (Diploma) 
 8 
 51 
 Sericulture
 8 
 3. The number of post for Item No. 25 (a) SDO (Civil Engineering) 
 (Class-I Gazetted) under Public Health Engineering Department shall be increased from 2(two) to 4 (four)
posts. {(1 post Unreserved, 2 posts reserved for Indigenous Inhabitants of
Nagaland, 1 post reserved for B.T. Yimchunger(Yimkhiung/Tikhir)} 
 4. The essential Educational Qualification
of the following Item No(s) shall be as follows: 
 Item No.45: B.Sc Agri. Science and above. 
 Item No.46: Bachelor’s Degree in Civil Engineering. 
 Item No.47: 3 (three) years Diploma in Printing
Technology. 
 Item No.48: (a) MBBS from a recognized
University duly recognized by Medical Council of India (MCI) /NMC 
 (b) BDS 
 (c) Degree/ Diploma course in Pharmacy from a
recognized University and registered in the state Pharmacy Council. 
 Item No.49: B.V.Sc
&A.H/B.V.Sc. 
 Item No.50(a): BDS 
 Item No.50(b): (i) Diploma in Pharmacy(D.Pharm)
 (ii) Bachelor in pharmacy (B.Pharm) 
 (iii) Doctor of Pharmacy (Pharm. D) 
 Diploma/Degree/Doctor from a recognized University and registered in the
State Pharmacy Council. 
 Item
No.51: 
 B.Sc PGDS/BSc Sericulture/MSc
Sericulture/ B.Sc (Agri) PGDS 
 5. The Pay Matrix/Level for Item No(s) 23 (a)(b)(c)(d)&(e) 
shall be read as 10 and not as rendered. 
 6. The
Syllabus for Item No.5 (APP) has
been updated (in some topics in Paper-II) as per the Department of Law & Justice letter No.LAW/PE-23/2016 dated 26 th 
June 2026, therefore candidates appearing in Law paper are informed to download
the updated syllabus from the Commission website. 
 7. The post of Vice Principal (Item No. 20(a) has been kept in abeyance as
per the Department of Labour and
Employment, Skill Development letter
No. EMP-2/147/2013 dated 7 th July 2026. 
 Other
terms & conditions of the advertisement remain the same. 
 (NUNGSANGMENLA 
 IMCHEN) 
 Secretary, 
 Nagaland Public Service Commission
